title: SECTIONMANAGER/SECTIONSETTINGS OBJECTS allocation rollback and retry
scope: Sweep the measured allocations in the dx_iface SECTION OBJECTS callback for a bounded VIEW-to-SECTIONOBJECT-to-SECTIONSETTINGS graph, checking whole-output rollback and same-adapter retry.

source.profile: AC1027 generated ASCII and Binary DXF containing a VIEW group-334 reference, SECTIONMANAGER membership, nested SECTIONSETTINGS source and geometry fields, and an in-memory SECTIONOBJECT callback.

method.calibration: For each encoding, perform one successful export with a high allocation countdown armed at entry to dx_iface::writeObjects; compute the allocation count from the remaining countdown.
method.injection: For every calibrated offset, import a fresh generated graph, seed the destination with a sentinel, inject one std::bad_alloc during writeObjects, and let the exception unwind through dxfRW's whole-operation transaction.
method.rollback: Require export refusal, exactly one injected allocation failure, entry into the OBJECTS callback, and byte-for-byte preservation of the sentinel destination.
method.retry: Disable injection and export again with the same dx_iface instance and source dx_data; fresh-import the result and check VIEW, SECTIONOBJECT, SECTIONMANAGER membership, SECTIONSETTINGS source identity, and nested geometry fields.

validation.asanBuild: cmake -S . -B build-asan-custom -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 && cmake --build build-asan-custom --target libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests --parallel 4: PASS

qualificationLimits: This covers the bounded SECTIONMANAGER/SECTIONSETTINGS callback profile and its enclosing DXF publication transaction only; it does not sweep every OBJECTS builder or every whole-document failure boundary.
Inputs are generated local test vectors, not physical producer files.
No native section-generation or 3D semantics are qualified, and no support claim is promoted.
